summary: Iteration 3 re-audit after /ases-fix. All critical + major findings from iteration 2 are resolved: (F-092-1, F-092-2) the 6 V2 include_router calls now carry prefix='/api/v1' — auth/users/pricing/invoices/report_export/inward_report endpoints resolve at the paths DS-010 and TC-208..TC-217 expect, and oauth2_scheme.tokenUrl='/api/v1/auth/login' matches the live mount; (F-092-3) inward_report.py imports were repaired out-of-scope (src.-prefixed), consistent with the other 5 V2 routers and main.py's own import path. The sole residual (F-092-4) is a minor stylistic drift — the 5 non-auth V2 routers rely on route-level Depends(get_current_user) instead of mount-level dep — flagged as is_adr_tradeoff, behaviorally equivalent under FastAPI dep dedup, TC-213 unaffected. backend/src/main.py:57-72 keeps mount-level Depends(get_current_user) off the 5 non-auth V2 routers, relying on per-route Depends declared in each router file. FastAPI dedupes identical Depends within a single request, so behavior is equivalent to the LLD-prose approach. TC-213 only exercises V1 mounts and passes. The intent is documented inline (comments on lines 64 and 68-69). Since severity is minor + is_adr_tradeoff and the previous critique explicitly listed 'Option B: accept as-is' as valid, this residual does not block CLEAN.
